# Remote sub-actions

## Send remote signal

Sends a named message (a signal) to another Cuebot on your network, so it can react. For example, tell your second PC to start a scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Instance** | Which other Cuebot to send to, by the name in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to send to every connected Cuebot. |
| **Signal name** | The signal's name, like "go-live". The other Cuebot listens for this name. Required. |
| **Include the action's arguments** | Tick to also send all the variables this action has right now. Untick to send only the ones typed below. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Arguments** | Extra information to send, one per line as name=value, like scene=Main. You can use %variables%. These are always sent. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%remoteSignalSent%` | How many Cuebots received the signal |

<small>Type id: `remote.sendSignal`</small>

## Wait for remote signal

Pauses this action until another Cuebot sends a signal with a certain name. Only signals that arrive after the pause starts count.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Instance** | Only accept the signal from this Cuebot, by the name in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to accept it from any. |
| **Signal name** | The signal's name to wait for, like "go-live". Required. |
| **Timeout (ms, 0 = wait forever)** | How long to wait, in milliseconds (30000 is 30 seconds). Use 0 to wait forever. Starts as: `30000`. |
| **Stop the action on timeout** | Tick to stop this action if no signal arrives in time. Untick to carry on with the next step anyway. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Overwrite variables** | Tick to let the signal's information replace variables of the same name this action already has. Untick to keep your own. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%signalReceived%` | True when the signal arrived |
| `%signalTimeout%` | True when the wait ran out of time |
| `%signalName%` | The name of the signal that arrived |
| `%signalSender%` | The name of the action that sent it |
| `%instanceName%` | The name of the other Cuebot |
| `%instanceLabel%` | The name you gave it in your settings |

<small>Type id: `remote.waitForSignal`</small>
